6.23 rsDataRegionInTableDetailRow
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsDataRegionInTableDetailRow is a critical error that will occur when a Table, List, Matrix, SubReport,
or Chart exists inside of a TableRow within a Details.TableRows element.
